note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. There was no contest: nine Unionists and six Nationalists were nominated for the 16 seats, with no nomination for Beaghmore (Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1958, p. 11). All sixteen divisions are recorded from the Returning Officer's Notice of Result, dated 6 June 1958 (Mid-Ulster Mail, 7 June 1958, p. 8): fifteen returned without a poll and Beaghmore's retiring councillor, Peter Conway, deemed re-elected. No labels are printed. Returned unopposed.
